intro: Two manufacturing units in Faridabad, 1,100 sq. yards of combined floor area, and 144 kVA of standby generation. The layout is deliberate: forming and fabrication in one unit, machining, tooling and inspection in the other, so heavy press work never sits next to precision measurement.

headline.label: Total plant area across two units

power.note: Full standby generation covers the press shop, laser, welding and machining lines. Grid outages do not become delivery delays — a distinction that matters when your line is running to a daily call-off.

pressBreakdown.caption: Power press capacity distribution
pressBreakdown.note: 250-tonne H-frame capacity handles heavy draw and forming work, while the same shop scales down to precision brackets and clips on 20-tonne presses.
